package audio

// ddsonic probe adapter for the active tree (patch 0002); the base has
// audio_probe_adapter_base.go.txt in its place, with the same function.
//
// Observation: the patched receiver counts each answer it takes that finds
// no live request (L5's discard, p.unknown) and logs nothing. Like the base
// adapter, it counts only answers the receiver has taken.

// bpUnknownAnswers is how many answers the provider took that found no live
// request.
func bpUnknownAnswers(p *KeyProvider, _ *bpLogger) uint64 {
	p.mu.Lock()
	defer p.mu.Unlock()
	return p.unknown
}
